answer: Each challenge is derived from a domain-separated hash of the participant’s commitment and a future drand quicknet threshold-BLS beacon pulse, so its unpredictable value is unavailable when commitments are submitted. A quartz, jetty, or juniper task label cannot be reused across rounds: answers must bind to the pulse and round identifier, then be revealed for verification. This blocks advance computation and offline answer farming, though sybil resistance still depends on limiting identities or making each attempt costly.
